service.description: The records awaiting adoption: the campaigns with no organization, the lists that are not mailboxes and the segments whose owner is empty or _NA_, at most 200 of each, each with recordKind (campaign, list, segment), kindName, recordId, label, detail (status or type), lastUpdatedStamp (the revision apply#Adoption names) and revision (the same as millis, for a form); counts by kind. Changes nothing. Refuses a caller without MARKETING_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED).

Assigns each record of assignments (maps of recordKind, recordId, organizationPartyId and the lastUpdatedStamp read) to an organization of the administrator's scope, each on its own transaction with one result: a list's or a segment's ownerPartyId, or a campaign's organizationPartyId with its dated MarketingOrganization MarketingCampaignParty row, each audited with the change reason "Adopted by" the administrator. Unknown historical consent stays unknown: nothing but the owner changes. A result is adopted, or refused by reasonCode with the others applied: UNKNOWN_KIND; RECORD_UNAVAILABLE for a record that is missing or a mailbox; ALREADY_OWNED for a record that belongs to an organization (an adoption applies once per record, the record read locked); REVISION_REQUIRED for an assignment that names no revision; REVISION_CHANGED for a revision that is not the one read, naming the current one; ORGANIZATION_DENIED for an organization outside the scope. Refuses a caller without MARKETING_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED).

parameter.name: assignments
parameter.description: Maps of recordKind, recordId, organizationPartyId and lastUpdatedStamp (a Timestamp or its millis; required)

service.description: The campaigns of the caller's scope (design §3 CampaignList), filtered in the query: text (id, name or summary, ignoring case), an organization of the scope, status (one, open, or all), parent, a date range they overlap, a manager or contributor (mine: the caller); paged (campaignList with its page fields; pageNoLimit for an export, up to 1,000). Each row: name, status with its text and colour, organization, parent, dates, budget and actual cost in the campaign's currency, managers and revision (lastUpdatedStamp in millis). Refuses a caller who reads nothing of Marketing (PERMISSION_DENIED) and an organization outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).

A planned campaign (design §3 NewCampaign): its name, summary, organization (of the caller's scope, its MarketingOrganization row mirrored to organizationPartyId), manager (a person who works for it; the caller by default), parent (an open campaign of the same organization), dates (thru after from), currency (named, else the policy's, else the organization's accounting currency) and budget, at revision 1, the caller its author. Needs MARKETING_CAMPAIGN_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses another organization (ORGANIZATION_DENIED) and NAME_REQUIRED, DATES_INVALID, CURRENCY_REQUIRED, AMOUNT_INVALID, PARTY_INVALID, ORGANIZATION_MISMATCH, PARENT_CLOSED.

The plan of an open campaign (design §3 CampaignHeader) at the revision read (expectedRevision; REVISION_REQUIRED, STALE_REVISION naming the current one): name, summary, expected response and revenue; a change of the parent or the dates is material: the revision rises, the earlier approvals end and an approved campaign returns to Planned; refused in progress (CAMPAIGN_IN_PROGRESS) and closed (CAMPAIGN_CLOSED). Needs MARKETING_CAMPAIGN_EDIT on a campaign of the scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE otherwise).

The budget of an open campaign (design §3 Budget) at the revision read: budgetedCost, estimatedCost and costUomId (not changed once it has costs, CURRENCY_IN_USE), the explanation recorded as the audit reason; a material change (the revision rises, the approvals end, an approved campaign returns to review). Refuses as store#Campaign.

A dated party row of an open campaign (design §3 CampaignParties) at the revision read: action add or end of a manager or contributor (a person who works for its organization, PARTY_INVALID; the last manager kept while the policy requires one, MANAGER_REQUIRED), or the organization's successor (of the caller's scope; refused while the campaign has costs, links or related campaigns, ORGANIZATION_IN_USE), which ends the old row and is mirrored to organizationPartyId. A change of the organization or a manager is material. Refuses as store#Campaign and ROLE_INVALID, ACTION_INVALID.

A typed, dated link of an open campaign to a record of its own organization (design §14.1 CampaignAssociation): action add (CakList a list that is not a mailbox, CakSegment a segment, CakPromotion a store promotion, CakForm a form publication; an event and a page once their phases keep their organization, KIND_UNAVAILABLE) or end (campaignAssociationId); another organization's record ORGANIZATION_MISMATCH, a missing one RECORD_UNAVAILABLE; a current link of the same record answered again. Needs MARKETING_CAMPAIGN_EDIT on a campaign of the scope.

Starts an approved campaign (Approved to In progress, its start date now): it needs the approval of its current revision (APPROVAL_REQUIRED); STATUS_INVALID otherwise. At the revision read (expectedRevision: REVISION_REQUIRED, STALE_REVISION). Needs MARKETING_CAMPAIGN_EDIT on a campaign of the scope (PERMISSION_DENIED, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

Completes a campaign in progress: refused with the counts of its pending work (PENDING_WORK: open related campaigns; the sends and enrollments of later phases); STATUS_INVALID otherwise. At the revision read (expectedRevision: REVISION_REQUIRED, STALE_REVISION). Needs MARKETING_CAMPAIGN_EDIT on a campaign of the scope (PERMISSION_DENIED, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

Cancels an open campaign (Planned, Approved or In progress), the reason recorded on the status audit; its pending approval requests end with it (superseded); what was sent or registered stays. CAMPAIGN_CLOSED for a closed one. At the revision read (expectedRevision: REVISION_REQUIRED, STALE_REVISION). Needs MARKETING_CAMPAIGN_EDIT on a campaign of the scope (PERMISSION_DENIED, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

A new planned campaign from one the caller reads (design §3: a campaign template is a campaign duplicated): the name given (else "Copy of" it), summary, organization, open parent, currency, budget, managers and current links, new dates when given; its approvals, costs, files and notes stay with the original. Needs MARKETING_CAMPAIGN_EDIT and the campaign's organization in the scope.

A campaign of the caller's scope for its detail and plan print (design §3 CampaignDetail, §18): campaign (the plan, status, organization, parent, dates, budget, actual and expected amounts in its currency, revision, campaignRevision), parties (dated rows of its organization, managers and contributors), associations, children, notes (the native MarketingCampaignNote rows, read only), costs and costSummary (MarketingCosts.js; a source's Accounting details masked without its read permission), decisions (requests and decisions with self-approvals marked and those ended by a later change), pendingWork, approvalProblems, awaitingApproval and capabilities (what the caller may do now). As of a date (asOf) the parties, links, costs, notes and decisions are those in effect then. Refuses a caller who reads nothing of Marketing (PERMISSION_DENIED) and a campaign outside the scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

A cost of an open campaign in its currency (design §3 CostEntries, F81): manual (a description and an amount) or one Accounting line of its organization, never both (COST_SOURCE_INVALID): a purchase invoice item (invoiceId, invoiceItemSeqId; PAYABLE_VIEW or ACCOUNTING_VIEW) or a posted ledger debit (acctgTransId, acctgTransEntrySeqId; ACCOUNTING_VIEW), SOURCE_FORBIDDEN without the read; a line counted once by a campaign (SOURCE_ALREADY_COUNTED), its allocations over every campaign within its amount (ALLOCATION_EXCEEDS), in the campaign's currency (CURRENCY_MISMATCH); or the reversal of a cost (reversalOfCostId; ALREADY_REVERSED). actualCost is kept the sum of the campaign's rows. An operationKey answers a retry with the first result. Needs MARKETING_CAMPAIGN_EDIT on a campaign of the scope.

A campaign's costs, newest first (as of a date: those recorded by then), each with its source (masked without the source's read permission), amount and state (counted, reversed, reversal), and the summary: actual cost, budget, what is left and whether it is over. Refuses as get#Campaign.

Asks for approval of a target at its current revision (targetKind campaign; send P8, automation P11, KIND_UNAVAILABLE until built): a planned campaign (STATUS_INVALID) with what approval needs (NOT_READY naming it: an organization, dates, a budget currency, a manager), none pending at that revision (APPROVAL_PENDING); a stale targetRevision when given STALE_REVISION. The request is recorded (MarketingDecision MddRequested) and the holders of MARKETING_APPROVE who work for the organization told (MarketingCampaignApproval, its title the campaign's name and revision), the author left out unless the one-person-team flag lets them decide; a failed notice is logged. Needs the author's edit permission (MARKETING_CAMPAIGN_EDIT) on a target of the scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

A decision on the pending request of a target (design §3 Approvals): approve or refuse (REASON_REQUIRED for a refusal; DECISION_INVALID) at the revision named (REVISION_REQUIRED; STALE_REVISION naming the current one), the target read locked so a draft is decided once (ALREADY_DECIDED; APPROVAL_NOT_REQUESTED when none is pending). The author (who started it or asked) never decides their own (SELF_APPROVAL) unless the organization's MarketingPolicy has the one-person-team flag on, for a campaign or a send to fewer than 500 recipients, recorded as a self-approval. An approval checks what approval needs again (NOT_READY) and approves the campaign (Planned to Approved); a refusal leaves it planned. The approvers' notices are read. Needs MARKETING_APPROVE (PERMISSION_DENIED) on a target of the scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

The approve service of the Marketing approval topics, which the framework's approve#NotificationMessage calls as the user: decide#MarketingApproval at the revision the notice names (targetRevision); a notice with none is refused (REVISION_REQUIRED), one of another record too (SOURCE_INVALID).

The refuse service of the Marketing approval topics, which the framework's refuse#NotificationMessage calls as the user: decide#MarketingApproval at the revision the notice names (targetRevision); a notice with none is refused (REVISION_REQUIRED), one of another record too (SOURCE_INVALID).

A target's requests and decisions, newest first (as of a date for a print: those made by then): the decision with self-approvals marked, the revision, who and when, the reason, and whether a later change ended it; with the target's current revision. Refuses a caller who reads nothing of Marketing (PERMISSION_DENIED) and a target outside the scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

The MarketingPolicy in effect for an organization (none: the defaults, no self-approval and a manager required) and its history, newest first (50), with the self-approval limit (500, the user's call). Needs MARKETING_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED) and an organization of the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).

What a policy's values would change, nothing written (design §12 PolicyPreview): the requests awaiting approval its self-approval flag would affect, the planned campaigns that would need a manager, what is missing (a currency), and when it takes effect. Refuses as get#MarketingPolicy and NUMBER_INVALID, CURRENCY_INVALID.

A new MarketingPolicy for an organization from now, ending the one in effect (named as read: expectedPolicyId, empty for the first; STALE_REVISION otherwise): its currency, the one-person-team flag (selfApprovalAllowed, off by default), whether a manager is required, the audience limit, frequency cap and retention days, its explanation. Refuses as preview#MarketingPolicy.

Adds (action add) or ends (action end, marketingVocabularyId) a dated value an organization offers (design §12 Vocabularies): a ContactListType or TrackingCodeType enumeration (enumId, VALUE_INVALID), or a UTM source, medium or content code (vocabularyCode, as in a link, CODE_INVALID) with its label, channel and sequence; one current binding per organization, kind and value (VALUE_TAKEN). Needs MARKETING_CONFIGURE and an organization of the scope.

The values an organization offers, by kind and sequence (current ones, or with includeEnded every one): kind, value, label, dates. Refuses a caller who reads nothing of Marketing (PERMISSION_DENIED) and an organization outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).

A user's manager and contributor rows on open campaigns (not completed or cancelled), names only, for Admin's offboarding (resourceId role:campaign). Another user's need MARKETING_OWNER_CHANGE (PERMISSION_DENIED). Approvals go to the holders of the permission and a scheduled send keeps its approval: neither is a person's.

Moves one of fromUserId's campaign rows (campaignResourceId role:campaign) to toUserId from now: the row ended and the successor's started; a manager's move is material on a campaign not yet in progress. Needs MARKETING_OWNER_CHANGE (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a row the user does not hold (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a closed campaign (CAMPAIGN_CLOSED), a successor who is disabled or no person (OWNER_INVALID) or does not work for the campaign's organization (NOT_EMPLOYED).

Whether the caller sees a campaign (a Marketing reader of its organization; never an unowned one) and may change it (MARKETING_CAMPAIGN_EDIT while it is open): the record visibility of get#RecordLinkInfo and RecordFiles for the campaign and its files (CampaignAsset). A call with no user sees none.

A file of a campaign (CampaignAsset, the record files of get#RecordLinkInfo): the row, and the uploaded file saved through save#CampaignAssetFile. Needs MARKETING_CAMPAIGN_EDIT on an open campaign the caller sees (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, PERMISSION_DENIED).
Internal to create#CampaignAsset, which checks the caller: the file of a CampaignAsset row of that campaign.

return.message: RECORD_UNAVAILABLE: File ${campaignAssetId} is not of campaign ${marketingCampaignId}
